description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter controller for managing the state and data fetching logic of the home screen in an OTT platform. It includes the HomeController class, which handles loading the home feed, continue watching list, and cache updates via a ContentRepository.

classes.name: HomeLoadState
classes.description: An enum representing the loading state of the home feed (loading, ready, empty, error).

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the state, data fetching, and cache updates for the home screen. It handles loading the home feed, continue watching list, and responds to cache updates to refresh data.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed data from the repository, updates the state accordingly, and triggers background refresh of continue watching items.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads the list of recent watch history entries, fetches detailed content items for each, and updates the continue watching list.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the home feed and continue watching list based on the latest cache data.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the cacheBuster listener from the repository when the controller is disposed.
